sloka: तथा हि विपुलैर्नादश्चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः ।। ६.५१.४ ।।ूनां सुमहानादो मेघानामिव गर्जताम् ।तौ तु बद्धौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।अयं च सुमहान्नादः शङ्कां जनयतीव मे ।। ६.५१.५ ।।।।
transliteration: tathā hi vipulairnādaścukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ ।। 6.51.4 ।।ūnāṁ sumahānādo meghānāmiva garjatām ।tau tu baddhau śaraistīkṣṇairbhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।ayaṁ ca sumahānnādaḥ śaṅkāṁ janayatīva me ।। 6.51.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."
